detail_herdr_both: Sessions from both the terminal and the desktop app
footer_both: Shows sessions from both herdr and Herdr App. New sessions from the web still open in herdr.
footer_both_offline: The machine is offline. Your choice applies once it connects. Shows sessions from both engines.
footer_single: Shows only sessions from the selected engine.
footer_one_offline: The machine is offline. Your choice applies once it connects. Shows only sessions from the selected engine.
footer_set_several: Sessions from every checked engine are shown; new sessions from the web open in {engine} unless you pick another.
footer_set_empty: No terminal engine is enabled: only transcripts and sessions from other sources are shown, and none can be started from the web.
footer_set_offline: The machine is offline; the choice applies once it connects. {text}
sets_unsupported: This computer’s node is too old and uses the default engine only; the checked ones apply after updating the node.
also_open: Also open in {engines}: messages go here only
